prd.title: Citizen Ack Page
prd.overview: The Citizen Ack Page is Anjali's closure-ack surface — Confirm resolved (✅) or Reopen (❌) when an admin has resolved her incident. Closes MAJOR #2: VS15 + glyph characters rendering correctly + ack-window expiry surfaced. Bangla-first default; no countdown pressure on this surface. Tier 3 (light) but load-bearing for the closure loop with the citizen.

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/CitizenAckPage.tsx (351 LOC); emit CitizenAckAccepted + ChainReopened; MAJOR #2: VS15 + glyph chars + ack-window expiry

requirement.title: Mount route at /my-reports/:incident_id/ack for citizen
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for citizen.

requirement.title: MAJOR #2: VS15 + glyph characters render correctly
requirement.description: Bengali text with joining elements and glyph characters must render without boxes/tofu. Use VS15 (U+FE0E) text variation selector for emoji-as-text. Per lockdown 06-data-formats-lockdown.md.

acceptance.criterion: Bengali strings render without glyph corruption
VS15 applied to emoji-as-text (verified by codepoint inspection)

requirement.title: MAJOR #2: Ack-window expiry visible (24h from resolved)
requirement.description: Surface 24h ack-window from IncidentResolvedByAdmin event. Display "Acknowledge within {hours}h {minutes}m" countdown. Silent after window expires — no pressure on this surface per lockdown.

acceptance.criterion: Window countdown visible when window open
After expiry, "Acknowledgement window closed" message renders (not countdown)

requirement.title: ✅ Confirm resolved emits CitizenAckAccepted
requirement.description: ✅ Confirm resolved button (primary) emits POST /api/events with CitizenAckAccepted{actor: citizen, incident_id}. Toast: "Thanks for confirming. All set."

acceptance.criterion: Click emits CitizenAckAccepted with correct payload

requirement.title: ❌ Reopen opens reason picker + emits ChainReopened
requirement.description: ❌ Reopen button (ghost) opens reason picker. On confirm, emits POST /api/events with ChainReopened{actor: citizen, incident_id, reason}.

acceptance.criterion: Confirm emits ChainReopened with selected reason

requirement.title: Silent-closure reopen UI after 30-day window expiry
requirement.description: After 30-day ack window expiry, the page surfaces a low-pressure reopen option (for genuine regressions). Does not aggressively prompt the citizen.

requirement.title: Bangla-first default (no countdown pressure)
requirement.description: On first visit, locale = 'bn'. Operator toggle EN ↔ BN; preference persists in IDB. This surface intentionally avoids aggressive countdown visual treatment.

requirement.title: Trust band shows "resolved"; reporter-badge shows "anchor"
requirement.description: Render BandPill (✓ resolved) and reporter-badge chip (⚓ anchor) on header. Independent DOM elements.

requirement.title: MSW: ChainReopened event handler
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts POST /api/events to accept ChainReopened event type. Persist via idb-keyval.

requirement.title: MAJOR #2 reconciliation: VS15 + glyph chars + window expiry
requirement.description: Verify VS15 applied; verify glyph chars render correctly; verify ack-window expiry surfaced; verify silent after expiry.

acceptance.criterion: VS15 codepoint present in emoji-as-text DOM (verified by inspection)
Glyph chars render without corruption (visual test)
Window expiry shows closed message (no countdown)

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for confirm/reopen labels, ack-window messaging, reopen reasons, closed-window message. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: citizen-ack-page, …-header, …-main, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-ack-window-countdown, …-button-confirm-yes, …-button-reopen-no, …-reason-picker, …-reopen-reason-row.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Render Bangla strings; inspect DOM for tofu boxes; inspect codepoints for VS15 (U+FE0E). Glyph chars render; VS15 applied.
Click ✅; intercept POST /api/events; assert CitizenAckAccepted with correct payload. Confirm event fires correctly.
Click ❌; assert reason picker opens; pick reason; confirm; assert ChainReopened with reason. Reopen flow works.
Seed fixture with 30+ day-old IncidentResolvedByAdmin; assert silent reopen UI; assert no countdown. Silent closure renders correctly.
